notes: Run 1 (2026-10-31) covers the statistical regions Osrednjeslovenska, Gorenjska, Primorsko-notranjska, Obalno-kraška and Goriška; the eastern regions (Podravska, Pomurska, Savinjska, Koroška, Zasavska, Posavska, Jugovzhodna Slovenija) follow in the next run (the VZB register already lists them). Poison line: no animal poison information line found for Slovenia — the national toxicology centre (UKC Ljubljana) serves humans; the Veterinary Faculty small-animal clinic's poisoning FAQ (kmz.si) only tells owners to call a vet urgently, so use the 24-h clinics. National context: since a rulebook change (Uradni list 8 July 2026) private clinics are no longer obliged to run 24-h duty; the ministry (gov.si, 24 July 2026) says emergency help stays guaranteed via the public veterinary network but publishes no duty list, and no VZB/UVHVVR duty-rota page exists. Not verified / left: Bled and Kranjska Gora have no registered practice (nearest Lesce, Jesenice); own sites not opened (robots/bot check/redirect loop): vpt.si (Tenetiše, robots), vpp.si, obutitacek.si, veterinacerknica.si, halovet.si, veterina-idrija.si, elbivet.si, veterinarska-postaja.si; Diagnoza duty number conflicts between site and register; Klinika Loka's role in the Gorenjska rota is inferred ("kolegi iz Škofje Loke"), not stated by name. Run 2 (2026-10-31, west follow-up) added the leftover practices (Animavet, Emir kirurgija, Klinkon, Rex, NOE, Dobro ×2, Gaber, VP Litija, Capriola/Zapuže, Cvenkel, Etvetera, KŽK ×2, Medicus, VPT Tenetiše, A-VET Sežana, Fiziovet, VA Idrija PE Cerkno) plus Dr.Vet, Veterina Dora, Šekli & Kukovica, VA Dobrepolje, VA Zavetišče Horjul and the Ljubljana animal eye clinic; Jata (Domžale, Pivka — poultry) and Veterina Marc Lipica (horses) kept as small_animals: false. Left out: VA Vanja Knez (register only, species unknown), Veterina Marc Lokev (not on its site). Conflicts: NOE register address/phone differ from its own site (site used); Veterina Dobro Grosuplje register phone 051 302 835 vs site 01 786 31 70 (site used). Blocked sites in run 2: animavet.si, va-medicus.si, vpt.si, veterina-idrija.si (register/itis.siol.net used). Farm-only/institutional units (MORS, police dog unit, VOA, VA Preska, LuxEquine) intentionally omitted. Run 3 (2026-10-31, east) covers Podravska, Pomurska, Koroška, Savinjska, Zasavska, Posavska and Jugovzhodna Slovenija: 64 entries, 24 × 24 h (incl. the Tačka small-animal duty line 041 613 301 as duty_rota); independent check of all 24-h entries + 20 % sample: 32 checked, 2 fixed (Veterinarius Hoče 24-h claim only on a 2017 municipality page — re-check; VP Radgona address), 0 removed. No regional duty-rota page and no animal poison line found in the east. North-east notes: No official regional duty rota (dežurstvo) page for Maribor/Štajerska/Prekmurje/Koroška was found; VZB register has none, so no duty_rota entries — duty numbers are per clinic. No animal poison information line found (only UKC Ljubljana human Center za zastrupitve); no poison_line entry. Blocked/unreachable: veterinarska-bolnica.si and klinika-malezivali-mb.si (HTTP-only, redirect loop), veterina-dravograd.si (redirect loop), vpradlje.si (robots_disallowed), several own sites refused by fetch provenance (veterinarius.si, veterina-skarica.si, malezivali.si, veterina-vernik.si). curl to vzb.si blocked by proxy (403). Left out (register only, species unknown): Veterinarska ambulanta Vernik (Moškanjci 79, Gorišnica, 02 743 03 00), VP Dravograd (Otiški vrh 169, Šentjanž pri Dravogradu, 02 87 85 079), VP Radlje ob Dravi (Koroška c. 49, 02 888 07 06), VA Osterman (Podgorska c. 9, Slovenj Gradec, 02 884 51 02), Panvita Veterina (Rakičan), Veterinarski inženiring/Nabergoj (Moravske Toplice), NEMOVET (Lovrenc na Pohorju), KRI & ZA (Cirkovce, livestock), VA PP (Perutnina Ptuj, poultry), osemenjevalna središča Ptuj and Murska Sobota (insemination), VB Maribor PE Hoče/Ruše/Šentilj (folded into VB Maribor note). Conflicts: Eisner PE Klinika phone (own site 02 480 12 19 vs register 02 420 23 62), ŽAK phone (own 070 441 471 vs register 02 81 81 655), VB Ptuj website (register veterinarskabolnica-ptuj.si vs current vbptuj.si), Mlakar legal form (s.p. in register vs d.o.o. on site) — own site preferred. Mlakar (Ptuj) is open 8–19 daily with night duty 19–8 but never says 24 h, so emergency_24h=false. Tačka Ormož 24/7 refers to field team, not flagged. VB Maribor small_animals=true is not confirmed on an opened page (site unreachable) — verify before publishing. South-east notes: No official regional duty rota (dežurna služba) page found for Celje/Savinjska, Dolenjska or Posavje; the only rota-like source is the Tačka network duty line. No poison line found for these regions. Not readable: vzb.si initially (fetched later via search link), zamba.si (client error), veterina-trebnje.si (client error), veterina-zalec.si and veterina-nm.si (https->http redirect loop), veterina-lasko.com, veterina-mozirje.si, veterinajagodic.si (fetch tool refused URLs not surfaced by search) – these entries rely on the VZS register. Conflicts: VZS register vs own site for Tačka Ribnica (Lepovče 4 vs 43a) and Rogaška Slatina (ulica vs cesta) – own site used. VP Kočevje register 041 621 920 vs tourism page 01 893 14 20 – register used. Buba Novo mesto publishes two different hour sets – hours omitted. Zvitorepka has an 'Urgenca' page but no out-of-hours service. Left out: Vet BM Brežice and VA Rep Mokronog (only in the 2014 UVHVVR list, not in current VZS register); VOA Ihan farm units (Kočevje, Pristava – farm practice); Veterina Šoštanj, Toplica Topolšica, ZASVET Izlake, Farma Podlog (2014 list only). Metlika and Krško town: no register entries (Krško covered by ZVC Leskovec pri Krškem). The vf.uni-lj.si duty service is Ljubljana only.
